title: The address a screening's result is sent to (audit #76; the founder's Q1 (g), Q10 (a), Q11 (b) and Q12 of 2026-10-21)
assertion: The form hints at a likely typo of a large mail provider's domain (gmial.com, yaho.com, outlok.com, hotmal.com) and warns of an ending no top-level domain uses, in the browser and again on the server, and the prospect may keep the address as typed; only after the upload's own checks, the rate limit and the database's refusals for the submitter (closed, paused, the bounce budget, which spend no validation), the server asks DNS whether the domain takes mail (no such domain, a null MX, or neither an MX nor an address refuses; a timeout or a failure accepts) and SES whether the mailbox exists (a LOW validity, syntax, DNS or mailbox verdict refuses, a MEDIUM validity or mailbox warns, an error or a timeout accepts), the two together, so the added worst case is one 2-second timeout, and SES no more than the day's cap (1,000 in production, 50 in staging; past it the DNS check alone, MAIL_VALIDATION_CAP_REACHED logged and alarmed); an address on the refusal list (a screening permanent bounce, a global suppression list's bounce among them, matched by the address with its +tag kept, or abuse complaint, matched by the mailbox it reaches, in the last 365 days: trimmed, in any case, at Gmail its dots, its +tag and googlemail.com, and at Apple me.com and mac.com) is refused only after those checks and submit_screening()'s own, so a listed address gets the same answer as any other on every path that ends without an email (a ZIP the release cannot price, a mailbox SES cannot confirm), and a bounce of a +tag spelling refuses that spelling alone, while a customer stream's bounce or complaint, a transient bounce, the account's own suppression and a not_spam complaint put nothing on it; every refused address, whatever refused it, gets the same one sentence, which says nothing about an earlier screening or a customer's mail; a client or an email account with 3 screening permanent bounces in 7 days is refused (screening_bounce_budget), before and whatever the address, so it learns nothing of the refusal list, and the stream stays open; no log line names the address or its domain
noFileReason: The checks run on synthetic addresses with a stand-in resolver and validation; no file.
